content: The gbautomation.xyz contact form lost [redacted-local-path]5 months of lead notifications after its contact-notify Lambda was deleted. Rebuilt the notifier as a cron poll, migrated the form off a stale standalone Supabase project onto the canonical gbauto project, locked the leads table with RLS, and deployed the poller as a Mac Mini launchd job.

proof.sourceQuote: ADR 2026-05-19 — contact-form notifier + gbauto Supabase migration
